This notebook installs R and Python project packages after Spack and R have already been validated.

```{python}
import submitit
from rse_workbench.helpers import show_submitit_job
from rse_workbench.build_install import install_in_container
```

```{python}
executor = submitit.AutoExecutor(folder=str(SUBMITIT_DIR / "%j"))
executor.update_parameters(
    timeout_min=SLURM_HOURS * 60,
    slurm_partition=SLURM_PARTITION,
    mem_gb=float(SLURM_MEM.rstrip("G")),
    cpus_per_task=SLURM_CPUS,
    slurm_job_name=f"install-lang-{PROJECT_NAME}",
    mail_user=SLURM_EMAIL,
)
```

```{python}
LANGUAGE_INSTALL_COMMAND = r'''
set -euo pipefail

source /work/env/activate.sh

which R
which Rscript
which rv
which python3
which uv

rv sync
rv summary

uv sync || true

echo LANGUAGE_INSTALL_DONE
'''
```

```{python}
job = executor.submit(
    install_in_container,
    project_dir=PROJECT_DIR,
    singularity_sif=SINGULARITY_SIF,
    runtime_command=LANGUAGE_INSTALL_COMMAND,
)
job.job_id
```

```{python}
result = show_submitit_job(job)
if result is not None:
    print(result)
```

Stop here until language package installation succeeds.
